---
name: SQL Server instructions
description: This file describes the SQL Server code style for the project
applyTo: "**/*.sql"
---
# SQL Server Instructions

- use uppercase for SQL Keywords and TSQL commands (e.g., SELECT, FROM,WHERE).
- use lowercase for table and column names (e.g., customer_ID,order_date).
- use snake_case for table and column names (e.g., customer_ID,order_date).
- use singular nouns for table names(e.g., customer,order),
